scope: Two original CIFAR clients/two actual CPU TRAIN rounds over loopback HTTP and a real single-node local EVM development chain

profile.arithmetic: Both direct/protocol: FP32 local CNN/codec, float64 effective residual/subtraction/server model; math.fsum aggregation; FP32 projection into next-round CNN
profile.comparison: One actual local-training delta per client-round supplies independently encoded direct and HTTP/protocol arms; system equivalence, not independent quality replicates
profile.loss: FedLC-inspired explicit tau1 variant, not official reproduction

network.accounting_boundary: Actual serialized HTTP body bytes in both directions; client request wire HTTP headers counted by send(), server response exact serialized header/body writes. Excludes TCP/IP headers, TLS, retransmissions and remote-network/consensus cost. Includes diagnostic attacks, exact retries and receipt queries. Bridge RPC metrics are separately reported by Node.

chain.confirmation_rule: status=1, canonical transaction block hash, exact contract/chain/readback, head number minus inclusion block >=2 (two descendants; confirmations=3)

bridge_stats.confirmation_rule: canonical receipt.status=1 and current_head - receipt.block_number >= 2; single-node manually mined development chain
bridge_stats.counting_scope: HTTP JSON-RPC request/response body bytes at loopback proxy; excludes HTTP headers, TCP/IP, peer gossip and consensus
bridge_stats.chain_scope: Ganache single-node local EVM development chain; not a public testnet or multi-validator finality benchmark

adversarial_checks.scope: Real EVM eth_call reverts; no extra mined attack transactions

limitations: This diagnostic is not another main predictive-quality seed or twenty-client experiment.
Single-node Ganache development EVM with manually mined descendants does not establish PoW, multi-node consensus or public-chain finality.
The registry attests a binding of upload metadata/digest, not honest training, poisoning resistance or an embedded model watermark.
The server, its HMAC keys, SQLite incorporation authority, bridge/EVM endpoint and matching decoder remain trusted.
Fixed full participation retains OPEN/pending/old EF during a missing client; it resumes the same round when that client returns. Permanent dropout advancement is not implemented.
A chain registration never authorizes EF commit; only a fresh context-bound HMAC-SM3 INCORPORATED receipt does.
Recovery rebuilds the HTTP service and SQLite objects after deliberate connection closure; no process kill or OS crash was injected.
Float64 reference equivalence applies to this system profile, not to the original FP32/MPS main-training trajectory.
Observed loopback latency and gas are development diagnostic measurements, not production latency, throughput, network fees or consensus cost.
